statement: Solver landing consumes the proof cone: the landing review manifest carries a deterministic proof-cone selection receipt (tier, per-edge-kind counts, selector version, input digests) derived from the exact aggregate changed paths; a leaf-owner diff lands on its selected cone; selector/test-runner self-change and unknown-path diffs force the full suite; npm run test:quest-proof executes the receipt's selected tests through the existing fail-closed runner; and the selection rationale is recorded in the Quest landing receipt, making proof more auditable than running everything.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.
